briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this week while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute buildouts continue at record pace across hyperscalers. DialectForge protocol gains traction in multi-agent security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4-preview with advanced reasoning. Anthropic followed with Claude 4.5 Opus. DeepSeek R2 and Meta's Llama 4.1 open weights dropped days apart, narrowing the gap with closed labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC. Microsoft and Google each activated new 100k H100-equivalent clusters. Saudi sovereign fund committed $2.1B to regional AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs before 2027?
